title: Palladyne AI to Participate in 15th Annual ROTH Technology Conference
summary: Palladyne AI’s CFO and CCO will hold 1:1 meetings with institutional investors at the 15th Annual ROTH Technology Conference in New York on November 18, 2026.
body_markdown:
**SALT LAKE CITY – November 12, 2026** –[Palladyne AI](https://www.palladyneai.com/) Corp. (NASDAQ: PDYN), a U.S.-based technology company delivering intelligent autonomy software and mission-critical components for the defense and advanced manufacturing sectors, today announced that Trevor Thatcher, CFO, and Kristi Martindale, CCO, will participate in 1:1 meetings with institutional investors at the 15th Annual ROTH Technology Conference on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in New York, NY.


Qualified investors should contact their ROTH representative to set up 1:1 meetings with management.


**About Palladyne AI**


Palladyne AI is a U.S.-based technology company providing intelligent autonomy software and mission-critical components to the defense and advanced manufacturing sectors. Its patented collaborative autonomy technology enables drones, robots and other autonomous systems to work together in complex, high-risk environments, from the battlefield to the factory floor. The Company’s solutions are developed and operated in America and built to meet the stringent security and compliance requirements of government and industrial customers. For more information, including on GuideTech and Palladyne Aerospace and Defense, visit[www.palladyneai.com](http://www.palladyneai.com/) .
